////////

I am single,23 years old,( I was 22 when committing this
offence) and a native of Kompo,I am an employed workman,residing
in an unnumbered styled house at Chou Cha Cheur,Western district.
On August 14,1940 at 8 a.m. I met Zung Ah S (陳阿四) in
a small tea-shop behind the Jessfield Park. ( I made his
acquaintance previously in a gambling house). He told me that he
had been informed by his friend regarding a wealthy man who
was possessing the hobby of boxing, and residing on Hankow Rd.
He suggested that this man be kidnapped with a view to possibly
obtaining a ransom of $40,000 or $50,000. Moreover, he asked me
to join his action. When I agreed with his suggestion, he told
me if he got a more correct information, he would inform me
each
in the said tea-shop. Then we departed/other.
Next day,(15-8-40) at about 8 a.m. I again met Zung Ah
S and also Wong Zung Joong(王成瓊) in the tea-shop. We then
arranged to summon together at 9 a.m. on 18th outside at the
door of a bulb factory on Robinson Road for the purpose of
carrying out of kidnapping.
Accordingly on the said day, I went to the above address
and following my arrival, Wong Zung Joong(i.e. the 1st accused)
came also. Not long after Zung Ah S arrived in a Johnson Taxi.
At first I did not know that Zung Ah S had commandeered the
car. Later, he carrying a newspaper wrapped parcel, called me
and Wong Zung Joong to get into the car. When I was in the car
Zung Ah S told me that he had commandeered the car, and the
driver was also a false one who was called to drive the car
by him also.I did not ask the name of the driver.

我未婚，23岁，（作案时22岁），籍贯 Kompo，是一名受雇工人，居住在西区周家嘴（Chou Cha Cheur）一处无门牌号的房屋内。
1940年8月14日上午8时，我在极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）后面的一家小茶馆里遇到了 Zung Ah S（陳阿四）。（我之前在一家赌场认识了他）。他告诉我，他的朋友告知他有一位富商，爱好拳击，居住在汉口路。他建议绑架此人，以期获得4万或5万美元的赎金。此外，他邀请我加入他们的行动。当我同意他的建议后，他告诉我，如果得到更准确的情报，他会在那家茶馆通知我。然后我们各自离开。
第二天，（1940年8月15日）上午8时许，我又在茶馆里遇到了 Zung Ah S 和 Wong Zung Joong（王成瓊）。随后我们约定于18日上午9时在罗宾逊路（Robinson Road）一家灯泡厂门口集合，实施绑架。
因此，当天我前往上述地址，到达后不久，Wong Zung Joong（即第一被告）也来了。没过多久，Zung Ah S 乘坐一辆强生出租车（Johnson Taxi）到达。起初我不知道 Zung Ah S 已经征用了这辆车。后来，他拿着一个报纸包裹，叫我和 Wong Zung Joong 上车。上车后，Zung Ah S 告诉我他已经征用了这辆车，司机也是他叫来开车的假司机。我没有询问司机的姓名。

pages.en:
Sheet No. 2

On marching forth in the car Zung Ah S said that four men,
would not be able to overpower the intended victim, as the
latter could play boxing so it is necessary for us to get
one more man to help us in the kidnapping. Then Zung Ah S
left the car and not long after this, he came back with Zoo
Pao Zung (徐宝成) (the 3rd accused), and we set forth
together with him.

When Zung Ah S opened the newspaper wrapped parcel, he
took out three Mauser pistols. Several magazines containing
rounds of ammunition, and a pair of handcuff. He gave me one
pistol and twenty rounds. He also gave Wong Zung Joong one
pistol and ten rounds. Zung Ah S himself took out one pistol
with several scores of rounds, and gave the pair handcuff to
Zoo Pao Zung.

Then the car stopped at the mouth of an alleyway
where in the complainant was residing. Zung Ah S with me,
Wong Zung Joong, Zoo Pao Zung and the driver entered the
complainant's house. At that time the driver stood onguard
in the alleyway, and Zung Ah S produced his pistol,
intimidating the occupants to remain calm. Then he pointed
to one of the occupants who was told to be handcuffed by
Zoo Pao Zung.

When we brought the complainant out side the house
he struggled, resisting to go with us. The resulted in Wong
Zung Joong assaulting the complainant by striking his head
with his pistol butt. At that moment some one at the mouth of
the alleyway fired some shots at us, and we in turn did the
pages.zh:
第2页

开车出发后，Zung Ah S 说四个人无法制服预定的受害者，因为后者会打拳，所以我们需要再找一个人来协助绑架。于是 Zung Ah S 下车，不久后带着 Zoo Pao Zung（徐宝成）（第三被告）回来，我们便与他一同出发。

Zung Ah S 打开报纸包裹，取出三支毛瑟手枪、几个装有子弹的弹夹和一副手铐。他给了我一支手枪和二十发子弹。他也给了 Wong Zung Joong 一支手枪和十发子弹。Zung Ah S 自己拿了一支手枪和几十发子弹，并将手铐交给 Zoo Pao Zung。

随后，汽车停在受害人居住的一条弄堂口。Zung Ah S 与我、Wong Zung Joong、Zoo Pao Zung 以及司机进入受害人的住所。当时，司机在弄堂口放哨，Zung Ah S 亮出手枪，威吓屋内人员保持冷静。然后他指着其中一名住户，让 Zoo Pao Zung 给其戴上手铐。

当我们把受害人带出屋外时，他挣扎反抗，不愿跟我们走。结果导致 Wong Zung Joong 用手枪柄击打受害人的头部进行袭击。就在那时，弄堂口有人向我们开枪，我们也予以

pages.en:
Sheet No. 3

same . When I escaped through a shop, I found out my left leg
has been wounded. On crossing the street, a car passed
accross me. Hearing me to be involved in a traffic accident,
the car immediately stopped. Taking the advantage of the
opportunity, I thought to commandeer that car also. But an
armed C.P.C. sat in the car. I produced my pistol and disarmed
the C.P.C. and kept his pistol in my pocket. The driver was
not in the car at that time, and on finding that I was run
after by some one, I escaped through an alleyway, and was
finally arrested by a C.P.C. who seized my pistol as well as
my loot.
True statement.

Signed.

回击。当我穿过一家商店逃跑时，发现我的左腿受了伤。在过马路时，一辆汽车从我身边驶过。听到我卷入交通事故，汽车立即停下。利用这个机会，我想也征用那辆车。但车里坐着一名武装的中国巡捕（C.P.C.）。我亮出手枪，缴了这名中国巡捕的械，并将他的手枪放入我的口袋。当时司机不在车里，发现有人在追我后，我穿过一条弄堂逃跑，最终被一名中国巡捕逮捕，他收缴了我的手枪以及我的赃物。

(1) Zung Kyih Zung（鄭劍城），居住在多福居（Daung Wu）客栈的厨房。陈述说他观察到三名男子，其中两人持械，穿过客栈，其中两人受伤。目击者指认了第一和第二被告。

(2) Zien Sih Sung（錢錫生），多福居客栈的茶房，也佐证了第一人的证词。

(3) Kong Pah Sung（江柏生），多福居客栈的会计，也如上所述佐证了证词。

(4) Yang Ah Nyi（楊阿二），福州路364号雇佣的厨师，陈述说他看到两名持械男子，其中一人受伤，穿过店铺进入福州路。

Complainant moved to his present address in 1934,
establishing the Nyih Zung Industry Company, business
at present is flourishing, especially "up country".

Complainant is stated to have previously had
trouble with General Yang Hu, then Defence Commissioner
of the Woosung Shanghai Area, this, during the
latter part of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities around
Shanghai in 1937, he refusing to attend the Head-
quarters of General Yang Hu at No. 11 Route Doumier,
when instructed to do so. Due to this trouble
complainant enlisted the services of the late
Supt. Loh Lien Kwei to ascertain the reason for
his presence being required by General Yang Hu, also
to endeavour to assist him in pacifying the General,
and it was eventually learned that complainant had
been reported to be selling iron and rice to the
Japanese. General Yang Hu later withdrew from the
Shanghai area and although nothing further has been
heard, subordinates remaining in Shanghai, or having
returned, may have remembered the incident.

One other incident recalled, is that complai-
nant previously had in his employ an apprentice
named Woo Kwang(    ), who subsequently(time not
known), joined the French Police and was stated to

受事人于1934年搬至现址，成立了“日中实业公司”（Nyih Zung Industry Company，音译），目前业务兴隆，尤其在“内地”地区。

据称，受事人此前曾与杨虎将军发生过纠纷，杨虎当时任吴淞上海地区防卫专员。此事发生在1937年上海中日战事后期，当时受事人拒绝遵照指令前往杜美尔路（Route Doumier）11号的杨虎将军总部。由于此次纠纷，受事人聘请了已故巡官罗连贵（Loh Lien Kwei，音译）去查明杨虎将军召见他的原因，并试图协助他平息杨虎将军的怒气。后来得知，有人举报受事人向日本人出售铁和米。杨虎将军后来撤出上海地区，虽然此后未再听到相关消息，但留在上海或已返回的下属可能还记得此事。

另回忆起一件事，受事人此前曾雇佣一名名叫伍光（Woo Kwang，音译）的学徒，此人后来（时间不详）加入了法租界巡捕房，据称在

pages.en:

be on the detective staff, later upon several
occasions, visiting the complainant. Upon the
withdrawal of the Chinese troops for the Shanghai
area in 1937, Woo Kwang left the service of the
French Police and joined the "Asia Rehabilitation
Society", a Japanese sponsored organisation.

During 1938 Woo Kwang communicated by telephone
with complainant and informed him that the Japanese
were looking for him, due to having received infor-
mation that complainant was a member of a "Mobile
Unit". Later, (time not known) Woo Kwang led a
party of Japanese to complainant's home in Tiendong
Road, but no seizures were made and no arrests
effected.

Relatives of complainant interrogated in

they are connected with the present attempt to kid-
nap complainant.

侦探队任职，之后曾多次拜访受事人。1937年中国军队撤离上海地区时，伍光离开了法租界巡捕房的服务，加入了“东亚复兴社”（Asia Rehabilitation Society，音译），这是一个由日本赞助的组织。

1938年间，伍光通过电话与受事人联系，告知他日本人正在找他，因为收到情报称受事人是某“流动小组”的成员。后来（时间不详），伍光带领一群日本人来到受事人位于天潼路的家中，但未进行搜查，也未实施逮捕。

就上述事件讯问了受事人的亲属，他们认为这些事件与本次企图绑架受事人的案件无关。

instructed to proceed to Louga Station for the

是由已故巡官唐恩宽（Ton 'ion Kwal，音译）雇来担任张居玉（Zung Chuen Nyoh，音译，原文括号内中文为張居玉）的无武装随从的，张居玉与受事人同住，地址为天潼路831弄7号。

据称，此人每天工作时间为上午9点至下午5点，有时也担任受事人的护卫。星期日对此人来说是假日，但在1940年8月18日上午10时（案发日期），他违背往常习惯，前往天潼路，当被问及为何前来时，他说感到身体不适，认为走走对身体有好处。他一直待在寓所内，直到上午11时45分接到受事人被绑架和枪击的消息，随后，他奉命与亲属一同前往圣路加医院。

到达医院后，他奉命守在受事人病房门外，阻止闲杂人等进入，后来又奉命前往老闸捕房，试图辨认被捕人员。从那时起他便失踪了，此后杳无音信。一名叫王周氏（Wong Tai sz，音译，原文括号内中文为王周氏）的女子，即失踪者的妻子，被带到分局接受查询，但未能提供对调查有价值的信息。正与该女子保持联系，并将获取失踪者的照片。针对上述事件的进一步调查将继续进行。

Regarding the escape of the 3rd accused, it
was ascertained from the ricksha coolie Tsai Tsoong
Li that the ricksha was hired at the corner of
Nanking Road and Chihli Road almost opposite the
Hung Miau. The coolie was instructed to proceed
to Yu Ya Ching Road and Peking Road corner, and made
the journey via Nanking Road, Fokien Road, Ningpo
Road, Chekiang Road, Chefoo Road and was stopped
by C.P.C. 3289 on duty at the Chefoo Road, Yu Ya
Ching Road intersection.

During the flight of the 2nd accused he passed
through the Mau Zang Sing( 高興 ) wineshop, 407
Foochow Road, leaving a distinct trail of blood.
Whilst detectives were attempting to locate him by
following the trail, the latter stopped at the
entrance of the wineshop and, what might have proved
valuable time, was lost in picking up the trail.
This was due to the wineshop coolie Mau Kyi Ian
( 毛見南 ) aged 16 years, erasing the bloodstains
with a mop. Enquiries in the wineshop, which was
full of people, obtained a denial that anyone had
passed through the shop, and this was not disproved
until evidence of cleaning was observed, and the

枪击和逮捕相关人员的位置。

关于第三被告的逃跑情况，经查实，据人力车夫蔡宗礼（Tsai Tsoong Li，音译）称，人力车是在南京路与直隶路拐角处，几乎正对着虹庙的地方雇用的。车夫奉命前往虞洽卿路与北京路拐角处，途经南京路、福建路、宁波路、浙江路、芝罘路，并在芝罘路与虞洽卿路交汇处被正在执勤的华捕3289号拦下。

在第二被告逃跑过程中，他穿过了位于福州路407号的“高兴”（Mau Zang Sing，音译，原文括号内中文为高興）酒家，留下了一条明显的血迹。当侦探们顺着血迹试图定位他时，后者在酒家门口停下，而在拾取踪迹上浪费了本可能宝贵的时间。这是因为酒家的茶房毛见南（Mau Kyi Ian，音译，原文括号内中文为毛見南），16岁，用拖把擦去了血迹。在挤满人的酒家里进行的查询得到了无人经过店堂的否认，这一说法直到观察到清洁痕迹后才被推翻，并且

trail through the wineshop again renewed. By this
time, the 2nd accused had collapsed and had been
arrested and disarmed by C.P.C. 172. The sub-

The owner of the shop Mau Ching Ching(毛錦卿)
and manager Kao Tsung Wei(高宗輝) are both in

cleaned two or three bloodstains from the front of

No Police Officers can definitely identify any of

穿过酒家的踪迹再次被接续。此时，第二被告已虚脱，并被华捕172号逮捕并缴械。酒家的副经理于1940年3月20日（原文如此，疑为8月20日之误）被带到分局，他叫周光裕（Tsau Kwang Yue，音译，原文括号内中文为周光裕），声称案发时他正在虞洽卿路17弄的一家分店。店主毛锦卿（Mau Ching Ching，音译，原文括号内中文为毛錦卿）和经理高宗辉（Kao Tsung Wei，音译，原文括号内中文为高宗輝）均在乍浦（Zawahing，音译，疑指乍浦路或乍浦地区）。

I reside at No.28 Siau Sing Tsong off Robison Road.
At about 8.p.m. on the 15-8-40, I, together with Wong
Tuh Sung (not arrested) and Tsang Kwei Ling (2nd accused),
was taking a walk on Robison Road in the vicinity of the Koong
Yih Cotton Mill, when Wong Tuh Sung told me that he had a
friend surnamed Zung who had informed him that the proprietor
of a certain hong on Hankow Road was a wealthy fellow, and
that should this man be kidnapped, the ransom money to the
extent of $50,000.00 or at least $20,000.00 could be obtained.
Wong Tuh Sung added that should we (I and Tsang Kwei Ling)
agree to take part in the "work", he would supply pistols for
the commission of this crime.
Being unemployed, both I and Tsang Kwei Ling expressed
our willingness to participate. We then discussed the matter
regarding how to carry out the crime and the date of kidnapping.
Wong Tuh Sung stated that we would carry three mauser pistols
at the time of kidnapping and that he would come to my home
and inform me about the date of the intended offence.
At about 8.a.m. this morning (18-8-40, Wong Tuh Sung
and Tsang Kwei Ling came to my home, the former telling me
that this "matter" (Kidnapping) would be carried out at
10.a.m. same morning. Wong told Tsang Kwei Ling to stay at
my home with me and he left, stating that he was going to
locate his friend Zung and also to book a room in the Sai
Lodging House on Robison Road.
Later Wong Tuh Sun, returned in a hire M/motor and
told us the following story that he had during the interval:
pages.zh:
F.I.R.3237/40
第一被告

Doong（王瑞童），Wong Zung Joong（王成瓊），别名 Wong Zeu Rompo，年龄20岁，职业：无业，
J.D.S.324 郭瑞千
老闸捕房 1940年8月18日 翻译员：Sih Yun Pai（音译）书记员。
//////

我居住于罗宾森路（Robison Road）旁小星宗28号。
1940年8月15日晚上8点左右，我与 Wong Tuh Sung（未被捕）及曾桂灵（第二被告）一起在罗宾森路公义纱厂附近散步时，Wong Tuh Sung 告诉我，他有一位姓宗的朋友告知他，汉口路某商号的老板是个富人，如果绑架此人，可获得赎金五万元，或至少两万元。Wong Tuh Sung 补充说，如果我们（我和曾桂灵）同意参与这项“工作”，他将提供手枪以实施此犯罪。
由于失业，我和曾桂灵都表示愿意参加。随后我们讨论了如何实施犯罪以及绑架的日期。Wong Tuh Sung 称，在绑架时我们将携带三支毛瑟手枪，他会到我家通知我预定的作案日期。
今天早上（1940年8月18日）约上午8点，Wong Tuh Sung 和曾桂灵来到我家，前者告诉我，这件“事”（绑架）将在当天上午10点实施。Wong 让曾桂灵留在我家陪我，他自己则离开，称要去寻找他的朋友宗，并在罗宾森路的赛旅馆（Sai Lodging House）预订一个房间。
后来 Wong Tuh Sun 乘坐一辆租赁的汽车返回，并告诉我们在间隔期间发生的以下事情：

pages.en:
Sheet No.2

After having engaged a room in the Sai Sing Lodging
House on Robison Road (near to home address), Wong Luh Sung
was successful in locating one named Ah S who could drive
a m/car, and two other men, whom he (Wong) brought to the
lodging house room. Then Wong telephoned the Johnson's
Garage for a hire m/car. Upon the arrival of the hired car
to the entrance to the said lodging house, Wong Luh Sung,
under the pretext of removing certain articles, asked the
chauffeur to enter the room where he was detained and guarded
by two of Wong's men (names unknown). Then the chauffeur's
uniform was divested and worn by the man Ah S, who was able
to drive a car.

Wong Luh Sung then came to my home in the car driven
by Ah S, as stated above.

I and Tsang Kwei Ling entered the car, sitting at the
rear seat with Wong Luh Sung. I saw Ah S acting as a chauffeur
in uniform, occupying the driver's seat, and the man Zung sit-
ting beside.

Then Wong Luh Sung produced a paper parcel which contain-
ed 3 Mauser pistols. He gave one Mauser pistol, loaded, and
one magazine containing 10 rounds of ammunition to Tsang Kwei
Ling. The same firearms were given to me whilst Wong had for
himself the remaining Mauser pistol and 5 magazines containing
50 rounds of ammunition. The man Zung was in possession of
a pair of handcuffs.

The car was then driven to the mouth of an alleyway
leading to the complainant's home. We five alighted and
pages.zh:
第2页

在罗宾森路（靠近住址）的赛星旅馆（Sai Sing Lodging House）预订了一个房间后，Wong Luh Sung 成功找到了一位名叫阿S的人，此人会驾驶汽车，另外还找了两个人，他（Wong）将这些人带到了旅馆房间。随后 Wong 打电话给约翰逊汽车行（Johnson's Garage）租用一辆汽车。当租来的汽车到达上述旅馆门口时，Wong Luh Sung 借口搬运某些物品，让司机进入房间，随后司机被 Wong 的两名手下（姓名不详）扣留并看守。接着，司机制服被脱下，由会开车的阿S穿上。

如上所述，Wong Luh Sung 随后乘坐由阿S驾驶的汽车来到我家。

我和曾桂灵进入汽车，与 Wong Luh Sung 一起坐在后座。我看到阿S身穿制服扮演司机，占据驾驶座，而姓宗的男子坐在他旁边。

随后 Wong Luh Sung 拿出一个纸包，里面装有3支毛瑟手枪。他给了曾桂灵一支已装弹的毛瑟手枪和一个装有10发子弹的弹匣。同样的枪械也交给了我，而 Wong 自己保留了剩下的一支毛瑟手枪和5个共装有50发子弹的弹匣。姓宗的男子持有一副手铐。

汽车随后驶向通往受害人家的一条弄堂口。我们五人下车，

pages.en:
Sheet No.3

leaving Ah S on guard outside, entered complainant's home.
Wong Tuk Sung threatened the inmates with his pistol, whilst
Tsang Kwei Ling asked the inmates who was the proprietor.
Through questioning we effected the identity of the proprietor,
i.e. the complainant in this case, when he was handcuffed by
Zung who handed him over to me for removal. However, he
refused to leave with me, so I struck him on the head with
my pistol butt. On the complainant's again refusal, Tsang
Kwei Ling fired several shots from the rear, but I did not
know whether complainant sustained injury or not. Later a
foreign Police Officer, apparently on hearing the sound of
gun shots, arrived on the scene and effected my arrest with
ammunitions
pistol in my possession.

The absconded men are described as follows:
(1) Wong Tuk Sung, alias Zung Ah S, age about
28, height about 5'6", medium build, dark
square face (slightly pock-marked), long hair
combed back, wearing dark brown foreign style
clothing, native of Kompo.
(2) Ah S, age about 24, height about 5'7", slim build,
pale long face, hair cut short, wearing black
Cantonese silk short jacket and pants, native of
Kompo.

Signed and cross-marked:
pages.zh:
第3页

留下阿S在外面放哨，进入了受害人的家中。Wong Tuk Sung 用手枪威胁屋内人员，同时曾桂灵询问屋内人员谁是老板。通过讯问，我们确认了老板的身份，即本案受害人，随后他被宗用手铐铐住，并移交给我要带离。然而，他拒绝随我离开，于是我用枪托击打他的头部。在受害人再次拒绝后，曾桂灵从后面开了几枪，但我不知道受害人是否受伤。后来，一名外籍警官显然是在听到枪声后赶到现场，并逮捕了我，当时我持有弹药
手枪。

在逃人员的描述如下：
(1) Wong Tuk Sung，别名 Zung Ah S，年龄约28岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，中等身材，深色方脸（略有麻点），长发向后梳，穿着深褐色西式服装，籍贯广东（Kompo）。
(2) 阿S，年龄约24岁，身高约5英尺7英寸，身材瘦削，面色苍白的长脸，短发，穿着黑色粤式丝绸短夹克和裤子，籍贯广东（Kompo）。

On the 1-9-40, I came to Shanghai from Fusieh.
I stayed in Room 15 of the Tai Ping Lodging House,
Robison Road, which was engaged by my friend Tong Ah Sung,
alias Tung (□ □ □ □).

On the morning of 1-9-40, Tong Ah Sung
suggested that we should be associated, and discussion over
the matter was held between the following persons:
Tong Ah Sung, Tong Ah Joong (so accused), Tsang
Kwei Ling (□ □ □ □), Ah S, (not arrested) myself
and two others, names unknown.

Tong Ah Sung was the person responsible for giving the informa-

At 10.a.m. on 1-9-40, we 7 in all made further
discussion in the stated lodging house room, following which
Ah S telephoned the Johnson Garage for a hire M/car. Upon
the arrival of the hired M/car, the chauffeur was taken to
the room and his uniform divested, being then guarded by
the two unknown accomplices of our gang. The chauffeur's

Sung
Then Tong Luh/(armed with a Mauser pistol - seized),

On finding the complainant I handcuffed him, but as

1940年9月1日，我从福州来到上海。
我住在罗宾森路太平旅馆15号房间，该房间由我的朋友 Tong Ah Sung，别名 Tung（□ □ □ □）预订。

1940年9月1日上午，Tong Ah Sung 建议我们合伙，并在以下人员之间进行了讨论：
Tong Ah Sung，Tong Ah Joong（同案被告），Tsang Kwei Ling（□ □ □ □），阿S（未被捕），我自己以及另外两名姓名不详的人。

Tong Ah Sung 是负责提供情报的人。

1940年9月1日上午10点，我们共7人在上述旅馆房间进一步商议，随后阿S打电话给约翰逊汽车行租用一辆汽车。租来的汽车到达后，司机被带到房间，其制服被剥下，随后由我们要伙中的两名不知名同伙看守。阿S穿上了司机的制服。以便他能冒充租来汽车的司机。
Sung
随后 Tong Luh/（持有一支毛瑟手枪 - 已被缴获），Tong Zung Joong（持有一支毛瑟手枪 - 已被缴获），Tsang Kwei Ling（持有一支毛瑟手枪）和我（持有一副手铐）乘坐由阿S驾驶的汽车，前往山西路389/9弄。到达后，留下阿S在车内，我们四人下车，进入了受害人的住所。
找到受害人后，我给他戴上手铐，但由于

pages.en:
Sheet No.2

he refused to leave, we pushed him out. At the same time,
I heard □□□ □up□ saying that he would shot the complain-
ant to death upon the latter's again refusal to go. Later,
□□□ □n □m opened fire, wounded the complainant and I at
once run away. □ □ □ □□□□, to the alleyway I received
one shot □□ □□□ □□□ □□□□ public ricksa but was
arrested on □□□□ □□□□.

他拒绝离开，我们将他推了出去。与此同时，我听到 □□□ □up□ 说，如果受害人再次拒绝离开，他就开枪打死受害人。后来，□□□ □n □m 开火，击伤了受害人，我立即逃跑。□ □ □ □□□□，在弄堂里我中了一枪 □□ □□□ □□□ □□□□ 公共人力车，但在 □□□□ □□□□ 被捕。

At about 11.30 a.m. 13-3-40 while I was on patrol
walking South to North along Shanse Road between Foochow and
Hankow Roads, and about 15 yards from a small alleyway on the
West side of the road. I observed five or six male Chinese
forcing an other male Chinese from this alleyway. Two of
the men had Mauser pistols in their hands, so I realised they
were kidnapping the other man. I immediately drew and loaded
my service pistol and fired four shots at the group. They
retreated into the alleyway, the two armed men firing five or
six shots in my direction as they went. I followed to the
entrance of the alleyway and from the cover of the stonework
I fired another two shots at their backs before they disappeared
round a corner of the alleyway turning South.

Returning to the East side of Shanse Road I reloaded
my pistol taking cover behind a stationary lorry/truck. At the
same time I shouted to people at the door of a nearby lodging
house to inform Central Station by telephone.

I then returned to the alleyway and on searching found
one Mauser pistol discarded on a wooden staircase leading to
a house above the entrance. This pistol had 8 rounds of
ammunition in the magazine but none in the breech.

There being nothing else in the alleyway I returned to
Shanse Road where an unknown male Chinese shouted to me that
a male Chinese was lying in the doorway of a shop on the West
side of the road about 20 yards away. I went to this shop and
observed a wounded male Chinese lying half concealed behind
the door step. On seeing me pointing my pistol at him he

老闸捕房 1940年8月18日。

1940年3月13日上午11点30分左右，当我在福州路与汉口路之间的山西路上由南向北巡逻时，距离路西一条小弄堂约15码处。我观察到五六名中国男子正从这条弄堂里强行拖出另一名中国男子。其中两人手中持有毛瑟手枪，因此我意识到他们正在绑架另一人。我立即拔出并上膛我的执勤手枪，向这群人开了四枪。他们退入弄堂，两名持枪者在撤退时向我方向开了五六枪。我追至弄堂入口，利用石工作为掩护，在他们向南转弯消失在弄堂角落之前，又向他们的背部开了两枪。

回到山西路东侧，我躲在一辆静止的卡车/货车后面重新装填手枪。同时，我向附近一家旅馆门口的人群呼喊，让他们通过电话通知中央捕房。

随后我返回弄堂搜查，发现在入口上方通往房屋的木楼梯上丢弃了一支毛瑟手枪。这支手枪的弹匣中有8发子弹，但枪膛内没有子弹。

弄堂里没有其他东西，我回到山西路，一名不知名的中国男子向我喊道，在约20码外路西的一家商店门口躺着一名中国男子。我走到这家商店，看到一名受伤的中国男子半隐蔽在门阶后面。当他看到我用手枪指着他时，他

pages.en:

hold up his hands and I then saw that he was handcuffed. He
told me that he was the complainant and I went to the lodging
house and telephoned for an ambulance and had him removed to
Hospital.

By this time a party had arrived from Central Station
and I joined them in searching the vicinity for the absconded
men.

I am C.P.C.1235 attached to Central Station.
On the 18-8-40, being on 2nd Day, I was detailed
for duty at the corner of Foochow and Shanse Road (i.e. 54th
Post). At about 11.a.m. 18-8-40, my Police Note-book was
signed by P.S.280. Following this I walked towards North
from Foochow Road when I suddenly heard the sound of gun-shot
coming from a certain alleyway. I immediately drew out my
service pistol and went forward to investigate the matter.
At this juncture, I saw two male Chinese dressed in
(1) grey cloth jacket and pants
(2) grey foreign style clothing
running out of an alleyway. The 2nd man on seeing me opened
fire at me and I returned two shots. They returned back to
the alleyway and continued running. I, joined by P.S.280
gave chase, but later lost sight of them, they decamping
among a number of persons. We made search in the alleyway
which resulted in the finding of a Mauser pistol beside a
staircase located at the entrance of the lane. Further
enquiries revealed that one of the robbers had been arrested
by another C.P.C.
At Louza Station I identified the arrested man being
one of the two robbers who ran out of the alleyway and fired
shot at me. (The recognized man being Yong Zung Joong - 1st
accused).

True statement.

Signed.

F.I.R.3237/40.

C.P.C.1235 Kyi Sui Ong（李秀宏），(C)
本人

我是隶属于中央捕房的 C.P.C.1235。
1940年8月18日，正值第二天值班，我被派往福州路与山西路路口（即第54岗）执勤。1940年8月18日上午11点左右，警司 P.S.280 在我的警务笔记本上签字。随后我从福州路向北行走，突然听到某条弄堂传来枪声。我立即拔出席勤手枪，上前调查此事。
就在此时，我看到两名身穿
(1) 灰色布夹克和裤子
(2) 灰色西式服装
的中国男子从一条弄堂跑出来。第二名男子看到我后向我开火，我还击了两枪。他们退回弄堂并继续奔跑。我与 P.S.280 汇合后进行追捕，但后来失去了他们的踪迹，他们混入人群中逃窜。我们对弄堂进行了搜查，结果在巷口楼梯旁发现了一支毛瑟手枪。进一步查询显示，其中一名劫匪已被另一名 C.P.C. 逮捕。
在老闸捕房，我辨认出被捕者就是从弄堂跑出来并向我也开枪的两名劫匪之一。（被认出者为 Yong Zung Joong - 第一被告）。

陈述属实。

签名。

Louza Stn., 18-8-40, translated /////// Clara Chen Chung Chi.

At 11 a.m. 18-8-40 I reported to Station on duty and
instructed to deliver Stolen Property Notices to silver smiths
shops. Whilst walking on the roadway on Pekien Road near
Soochow Road at about 11.40 a.m., I saw a man on the pavement
five yards in front of me proceeding from north to south along
Pekien Road and I observed that he held a Mauser type pistol
in his hand, and that his pants were covered in blood.
Realising that this man was a robber, I drew out my pistol
followed behind him as he entered lane 140 Pekien Road. He sat
on the ground at the entrance of the alleyway and I ordered
him to put his pistol on the ground. I then picked up the
Mauser type pistol with my left hand.
I saw C.P.V.1186 nearby and ordered him to call a C.P.C.
whose number is 3245, and he came and searched the person
of the arrested man, recovering a pistol S.H.C.No.3315 from
his person. Simultaneously Chinese and foreign detectives and
Chinese and foreign Inspectors arrived, so I handed over the
pistols seized to Foreign Inspector Beerman, and the arrested
man was sent to the Hospital by F.B.Ambulance.
I then came to the station and wrote this statement.

Yuen Ching Yue（老闸 C.P.S.172）。

老闸捕房，1940年8月18日，翻译 /////// Clara Chen Chung Chi。

1940年8月18日上午11点，我到捕房报到上班，并受命向银匠店分发失窃财物通告。上午11点40分左右，当我走在苏州路附近的北京路上时，我看到前方五码处的人行道上有一名男子沿北京路由北向南行走，我观察到他手中持有一支毛瑟型手枪，且裤子上沾满血迹。
意识到此人是劫匪，我拔出手枪跟随他进入北京路140弄。他在弄堂入口处坐在地上，我命令他将手枪放在地上。随后我用左手捡起了那支毛瑟型手枪。
我看到附近的 C.P.V.1186，便命令他呼叫编号为3245的 C.P.C.，该警员赶到后搜查了被捕者的身体，从其身上搜出一支编号为 S.H.C.No.3315 的手枪。与此同时，中外侦探及中外督察抵达，我将缴获的手枪移交给外籍督察 Beerman，被捕者由法租界救护车送往医院。
随后我回到捕房并写下这份陈述。

pages.en:
C. P. C. 3249.

Louga Stn.,          20-8-40,          translated
                                      ////////          Clerk Sih Yua Pai.

Between 11 a.m. and 3 p.m. on 18-8-40, I was detailed for
Post duty at the corner of Pekien and Foochow Roads.
At about 11.30 a.m. 18-8-40, I heard the sound of one gun
shot coming from the direction of Shanse Road and Foochow Road.
I immediately drew out my service pistol and went forward to
investigate the matter.
A short time later, I heard from a C.P.W.1196 that an
injured robber was in Lane 140 off Pekien Road. On obtaining
this information, I immediately proceeded to the lane where I
saw C.P.S.172 covering the injured robber who was bleeding from
the lower portion of his body. C.P.S.172 had a Mauser pistol in
his left hand. I searched the robber and found S.M.P. pistol,
No. 3315 together with one magazine containing 6 rounds of
ammunition in his pocket. The seized firearms were later handed
over to an Inspector attached to this station.
True statement.
pages.zh:
C. P. C. 3249.

老闸捕房，          1940年8月20日，          翻译
                                      ////////          书记员 Sih Yua Pai。

1940年8月18日上午11点至下午3点之间，我被派往北京路与福州路路口执行岗哨任务。
1940年8月18日上午11点30分左右，我听到来自山西路和福州路方向的一声枪响。我立即拔出席勤手枪，上前调查此事。
不久后，我从 C.P.W.1196 处得知，北京路140弄内有一名受伤的劫匪。获得此信息后，我立即前往该弄堂，在那里我看到 C.P.S.172 正在看守一名下半身流血的受伤劫匪。C.P.S.172 左手持有一支毛瑟手枪。我搜查了该劫匪，在其口袋中发现了一支工部局警务处手枪，编号3315，以及一个装有6发子弹的弹匣。缴获的枪械随后移交给隶属于本捕房的一名督察。
陈述属实。

pages.en:
C.P.C.1582 attached to the Central Station.
Self
translated
Louza Stn., 18-8-40, Clark Koo Ting-I.

I was detailed to escort M/truck Lic.No.23632 loaded with
rice from the Bund to a godown on Moulin Rd between 10 a.m.
and 12 m.n. 18-8-40.

At about 11.30 a.m. even date, I was sitting beside the
chauffeur in the said M/truck proceeding west along Foochow Rd,
about 10 yards west of Shanse Road. Suddenly a male Chinese
armed with a Mauser Pistol pointed at us approached from the
north side of the road and compelled the chauffeur to stop the
M/truck. This was done under threats. The robber all the time
covering us with the pistol in his hand walked from the right
side of the M/truck to the left side where he opened the door
of the truck and ordered me to hand my pistol to him. At the
same time he informed his accomplice behind whom I did not use
to keep a sharp watch. He then took the pistol from my person
and decamped. At no time was I given the opportunity to offer
resistance. Having run at a distance of about 4 or 5 yards
away he turned round and fired one shot at me. I immediately ran
into a watch shop on the south side of the road and used the
telephone to report the matter to Station. At the same time
C.P.C.1527 also came to this shop for the purpose of using
a telephone and I informed him of what had happened. Soon after,
I together with C.P.C.1527 ran west along Foochow Road with the
view to arresting the robber who took away my pistol. When
nearing Pakien Road I observed C.P.C.172 Louza having effected
the arrest of the robber who took away my pistol which was in
custody of C.P.C.3248. I later followed Louza Police party to
Louza Station where I made my report.
pages.zh:
中央巡捕房警员编号1582，隶属于中央捕房。
自译
老闸捕房，1940年8月18日，郭定一（Clark Koo Ting-I）。

我奉命于1940年8月18日上午10时至午夜12时之间，护送一辆装载大米的机动卡车（牌照号23632），从外滩前往慕尔鸣路（Moulin Rd.）的一处仓库。

同日约上午11时30分，我坐在上述机动卡车的司机身旁，沿福州路向西行驶，行至距山西路以西约10码处。突然，一名手持毛瑟手枪的中国男子从道路北侧向我们逼近，并威胁司机停下机动卡车。该劫匪全程用手中的手枪指着我们进行威慑，他从机动卡车的右侧走到左侧，打开车门，命令我将手枪交给他。同时，他向其同伙发出信号，而我此前并未对其保持严密警戒。随后，他从我身上夺走手枪并逃窜。在此期间，我没有任何机会进行反抗。他跑出约4或5码远后，转身向我开了一枪。我立即跑进路南的一家钟表店，使用电话向捕房报告此事。与此同时，中央巡捕房警员编号1527也来到该店使用电话，我便将发生的情况告知了他。不久之后，我与中央巡捕房警员编号1527一起沿福州路向西奔跑，试图逮捕夺走我手枪的劫匪。当接近福建路时，我看到老闸捕房警员编号172已抓获了夺走我手枪的劫匪，该劫匪当时由中央巡捕房警员编号3248看管。随后，我跟随老闸捕房的警务人员前往老闸捕房，并在那里提交了报告。

pages.en:
Tsai Tsong Li.
Taichow. // // C.D.C.106,
Louza Stn. 18-8-40, translator
/////// Clerk Chen Hsu Kang.

My name is Tsai Tsong Li, 38 years of age, public ricksha
coolie, permit No.14023, residing at No.21 Sai Ming Fung, East
Poo Yah Dong Road, Nantao.

At about 11.45 a.m. on 18-8-40 when I was plying my
ricksha S.M.C.Lic.No.7039 for hire on Nanking Road near Chihli
Road opposite the Hung Miao, a male Chinese shouted for a ricksha.
I immediately approached him whereupon he ordered me to take
him to Yu Ya Ching - Peking Roads without talking over the
fare for the journey.

He boarded my ricksha and I proceeded west along Nanking
Road to Fokien Road, where I turned northward, and then
westward into Ningpo Road. I proceeded to Chekiang Road where
I turned northward till I reached Chefoo Road, where I proceeded
westwards. On arriving at the intersection of Chefoo and Yu Ya
Ching Roads, a Policeman stopped my ricksha asking the passenger
how he had blood stains on his body. My passenger stated that he
was injured in a fight and that he was going to a hospital for
treatment. As this answer did not meet with the satisfaction of
the Policeman we were brought to the Station by him for
enquiries.

Thumb-printed: Tsai Tsong Li.
pages.zh:
蔡宗礼（Tsai Tsong Li）。
泰州。// // 中央侦探社编号106，
老闸捕房，1940年8月18日，译者
/////// 书记员陈旭康。

我叫蔡宗礼，38岁，公共人力车夫，执照号14023，住南市东普育东路赛明丰21号。

1940年8月18日上午11时45分左右，我在南京路靠近直隶路、红庙对面处驾驶我的公共租界工部局牌照第7039号人力车揽客时，一名中国男子呼喊要车。我立即上前，他便命令我拉他去虞洽卿路与北京路交汇处，且未商议车费。

他坐上我的车，我沿南京路向西行驶至福建路，在此向北转弯，随后向西转入宁波路。我行驶至浙江路，在此向北转弯直至芝罘路，然后向西行驶。到达芝罘路与虞洽卿路交汇处时，一名警察拦下我的车，询问乘客身上为何有血迹。我的乘客称他在打斗中受伤，正前往医院治疗。由于这一回答未能使警察满意，我们被他带往捕房接受讯问。

按指印：蔡宗礼。

pages.en:
Zien Chiu Wu (錢九如), age 38,
Shinkiang                                C.D.C.160 Chou Chen Hsing
Louza Stn.          18-8-40              translated   Clerk Sih Yun Pai.
                                         //////

I reside at No.330 Route Joseph Prelupt, P.C.
I am a chauffeur employed at the Zai Foong Transport-
ation Company, 53 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, driving M/truck, Lic.
No.23632, my Permit Number being 13668.
At 11.30 a.m. to-day (18-8-40), having been loaded
with a certain quantity of rice from No.15 Wharf, the Bund,
I drove the truck to a godown on Moulmein Road, being
escorted by C.P.C.1582 attached to the Central Station.
On the car arriving at Foochow Road near Shanse Road
(proceeding westward), a robber approached me and ,
producing his pistol asked me to alight. I did as instructed
and decamped into a nearby book store. Later I heard one
shot being fired.
Afterwards I was instructed by a foreign Police
Officer to drive the car to Louza Police Station.
I did not know that the C.P.C. had been robbed of
his pistol.
The above mentioned robber is described as follows:
Height about 5'6", wearing grey/foreign style clothing.
As I was in haste to evade from the armed robber,
I did not pay attention to his description. Nor did I know
how the C.P.C. escorted the car had been threatened by the
armed man.

Signed.
pages.zh:
钱九如（Zien Chiu Wu），38岁，
新江                                中央侦探社编号160 周振声
老闸捕房          1940年8月18日              翻译   书记员施云白。
                                         //////

我住蒲石路（Route Joseph Prelupt）330号。
我是载丰运输公司（Zai Foong Transportation Company）雇佣的司机，公司地址为圆明园路53号，驾驶机动卡车，牌照号23632，我的执照号为13668。
今天上午（1940年8月18日）11时30分，在外滩15号码头装载一定数量的大米后，我驾驶卡车前往慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的一处仓库，由隶属于中央捕房的中央巡捕房警员编号1582随行护送。
当车辆行驶至靠近山西路的福州路（向西行驶）时，一名劫匪走近我，亮出手枪要求我下车。我照做并逃入附近的一家书店。随后我听到一声枪响。
之后，我接到一名外籍警官的指令，将车开往老闸捕房。
我当时并不知道随车护送的中央巡捕房警员的手枪被抢。
上述劫匪的特征描述如下：
身高约5英尺6英寸，身穿灰色/西式服装。
由于我急于躲避持枪劫匪，并未注意其体貌特征。我也不清楚持枪者是如何威胁随车护送的中央巡捕房警员的。

签名。

pages.en:
Kong Ah Hoong (江阿宏), age 39,
J.D.S.160 Chow Chen Hsing
translated Clerk Sih Yun Pai.
//////

Tungchow
Louza Stn. 18-8-40

I am a chauffeur, Driving Permit No.7979, employed
at the Johnson's Garage, 11th Branch, located at the corner
of Medhurst and Jinza Roads. I reside at No.7 Lane 252
Connaught Road, corner of Tonguin Road.

At about 10.15 a.m. 18-8-40, instructions received
from the garage office that hire service had been requested
by the occupants of Room 16, Sai Shing Lodging House, Robison
Road, West of Penang Road, and I was detailed for the work.
I drove K/car, Lic. No.17073, to the stated lodging house on
Robison Road where upon arrival, one man:

(1) age about 28, height about 5'6", thin purple face,
short hair, wearing Cantonese silk jacket and pants,
Kompo dialect,

who was standing outside the premises, approached the car
and asked me to go upstairs with him to remove some property.
I followed him to Room No.13 of the lodging house (upstairs)
when I saw two men present therein, their description being:

(2) Age about 24, height about 5'4", medium build,
pale square face, long hair combed back, wearing
white silk short jacket, black cotton pants and
gauze Chinese shoes, Kompo dialect.

(3) Age about 24, height about 5'3", slim build,
dark long face (pock-marked), wearing black jacket
and pants and a pair of dark glasses.

The 2nd described man immediately produced his pistol
and asked me to take off my chauffeur's uniform. He stated
that they, being Wang Ching-wei's men, wanted to borrow my
pages.zh:
江阿宏（Kong Ah Hoong），39岁，
特别侦探社编号160 周振声
翻译 书记员施云白。
//////

通州
老闸捕房，1940年8月18日

我是一名司机，驾驶执照号7979，受雇于约翰逊汽车行（Johnson's Garage）第十一分行，该行位于麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Rd.）与静安寺路（Jinza Rd.，即今南京西路）转角处。我住康纳特路（Connaught Rd.，即今海宁路）252弄7号，通温路（Tonguin Rd.，音译）转角处。

1940年8月18日上午10时15分左右，我接到车行办公室指令，称槟榔路（Penang Rd.）以西罗宾森路（Robison Rd.，即今南苏州路或相关路段，注：此处原文为Robison，通常对应Rue Robison，即今延安东路或附近，但结合上下文Sai Shing Lodging House可能指特定旅馆）赛星旅馆16室的住客要求租车服务，我被派去执行此项任务。我驾驶客车（牌照号17073）前往罗宾森路上的上述旅馆，抵达后，一名男子：

(1) 年龄约28岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，瘦削，紫膛色脸，短发，身穿广东式丝绸衣裤，讲高邮话（Kompo dialect），

当时正站在寓所外，走近汽车，让我随他上楼去取一些财物。我跟随他来到旅馆楼上13号房间，看到里面有两名男子，其特征如下：

(2) 年龄约24岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，中等身材，面色苍白的方脸，长发向后梳，身穿白色丝绸短上衣、黑色棉裤和纱质中式鞋，讲高邮话。

(3) 年龄约24岁，身高约5英尺3英寸，身材瘦削，黑长脸（有麻点），身穿黑色衣裤，戴一副深色眼镜。

上述第2名男子立即亮出手枪，要求我脱下司机制服。他说他们是汪精卫的人，想借用我的

pages.en:
Sheet No.2.

car in order to proceed and kidnap one man named Zung from
Central Hotel.
    Being intimidated, I took off my uniform with the
car's signature-o. This uniform was worn by the 3rd described
man who left the room. The 1st and
2nd described men remained and guarded me in
the room. Of the three men I could only see that the 2nd
described was armed.
    I was detained in the room until 12 noon when some
one knocked upon the door, and the 1st described man went out
and returned about 10 minutes later. He (1st described) said
that the borrowed car had been back, the man Zung kidnapped
and sent to the Headquarters, but at the time of kidnapping,
he added, shots fired.
    The two men remained guarding me and another 10 minutes
later, some body again knocked on the door and the 1st des-
cribed opening same went out. He returned to the room about
several minutes later and joined by the 2nd described, left
again, the 2nd described saying that they were going to
get $10.00 for the hire service, and also obtain some food
for me. Having remained in the room for about 5 minutes,
I went out of the room and asked a room-boy where the three
room occupants had gone. In reply he stated that they had
gone in a Westerly direction along Robison Road, having
occupied the room for only 3 hours.
    On obtaining the information I left the lodging house
and proceeded to the 7th Branch, Johnson's Garage, Kiaochow Rd.
pages.zh:
第2页。

汽车，以便前去绑架中央饭店的一名姓宗（Zung）的男子。
    在胁迫下，我脱下了带有汽车标识“o”的制服。这套制服由上述第3名男子穿上，随后他离开了房间。上述第1名和第2名男子留在房间里看守我。在这三人中，我只能确认上述第2名男子持有武器。
    我被关在房间里直到中午12点，此时有人敲门，上述第1名男子出去，约10分钟后返回。他（上述第1名男子）说借来的车已经回来，姓宗的男子已被绑架并送往总部，但他补充说，在绑架过程中开了枪。
    这两人继续看守我，又过了10分钟，再次有人敲门，上述第1名男子开门出去。几分钟后他回到房间，与上述第2名男子汇合后再次离开，上述第2名男子说他们要去收取10.00元的租车费，并为我弄些食物。我在房间里待了约5分钟后，走出房间询问一名茶房那三名房客去了哪里。他回答说，他们沿罗宾森路向西方向离去，在该房间仅停留了3小时。
    获得此信息后，我离开旅馆，前往胶州路约翰逊汽车行第七分行。

pages.en:
No. 3.

and thence to Bubbling Well Station, reporting the
occurrence.
I attended Louza Station Detective Office, Lester
Chinese Hospital and Police Hospital, but I could not
identify the three injured persons being the men whom I had
met this morning.

Signed.
pages.zh:
第3页。

随后前往静安寺捕房，报告了此事。
我去了老闸捕房侦探股、雷士德华人医院和警察医院，但我无法辨认那三名伤者就是我今天早上见过的那几个人。

签名。

pages.en:
Zung Sung Foo.
Nanking. // C.D.S. 88.
Louza Stn. 18-8-40. translated ////// Clerk Chen Hsu Kang.

My name is Zung Sung Foo, age 11 years, son of the proprietor of the Nyih Zung Industrial Works located at House 9 Lane 389 Hankow Road.

At about 11.15 a.m. on 18-8-40 five men, 3 wearing grey foreign style suit (2 armed with Mausers), 1 wearing brown striped foreign style suit (also armed with a Mauser) and 1 wearing white silk jacket and pants, entered the factory asking for Mr. Zung.

As we did not answer his question, 4 men, all in foreign dress, dashed into the downstairs west room where they found my father Zung Yien Ling who was then handcuffed by one of them, a pock-marked face. They dragged my father into the guest room with intention to take him out of the premises. As he refused to follow them one, wearing grey suit, hit my father on the head with his mauser.

However, my father was forced to go with them, at this time, the man wearing brown suit having kept us under guard in the courtyard. After a short while we heard 5 or 6 shots being fired outside the door whereupon the guard immediately left the house by the front entrance.

Later I was brought to the Station where I identified the following two persons who had participated the kidnappings:
(1) Zee Pau Zung who had handcuffed my father.
(2) Vong Zung Joong who had hit my father on the head with his mauser.

True statement. Cross-marked: Zung Sung Foo.
pages.zh:
宗颂福（Zung Sung Foo）。
南京。// 中央侦探社编号88。
老闸捕房，1940年8月18日。翻译 ////// 书记员陈旭康。

我叫宗颂福，11岁，是汉口路389弄9号日新工业社（Nyih Zung Industrial Works）老板的儿子。

1940年8月18日上午11时15分左右，五名男子进入工厂寻找宗先生，其中3人身穿灰色西式西装（2人携带毛瑟手枪），1人身穿棕色条纹西式西装（也携带毛瑟手枪），1人身穿白色丝绸衣裤。

由于我们没有回答他的问话，4名身穿西式服装的男子冲进楼下西面的房间，找到了我的父亲宗彦龄（Zung Yien Ling），其中一名麻脸男子给他戴上了手铐。他们拖着我父亲进入客厅，意图将他带出寓所。因他拒绝跟随，一名身穿灰色西装的男子用毛瑟手枪击打我父亲的头部。

然而，我父亲被迫随他们离开，此时，那名穿棕色西装的男子在院子里看守我们。过了一会儿，我们听到门外响了5或6枪，看守随即从前门离开了房子。

后来我被带到捕房，指认了以下两名参与绑架的人员：
(1) 季保宗（Zee Pau Zung，音译），给我父亲戴上手铐的人。
(2) 王宗荣（Vong Zung Joong，音译），用毛瑟手枪击打我父亲头部的人。

属实陈述。画十字标记：宗颂福。

pages.en:
Chen Zang Ming (陳長明), age 56,
Nanking                                      J.D.1.260 Hsu Fu Sheng
Louza Stn.              18-8-40              translated  Clerk Sih Yun Pai.
                                             ///////

    I am employed as a tea-boy at the Nyih Zung Tooth-
paste Factory, Lane 399/9 Hankow Road, and there I reside.

At 11.33 a.m. on the 18-3-40 the Station
alarm was sounded, following a telephone message
from C.C.I. stating that a shooting affray was in
progress on Chanse Road near Poochow Road. The
Officer i/c, Senior Detective, Louza Station and
general party of Uniform and detectives attended
the scene, as also did the Officer i/c. Senior
Detective Central Station with uniform and
detective party. D.C.(Crime), D.O."A" Div.,
D.P.S."A", D.I. Glover and D.S.I. Konovaloff,
attached to C.I also were in attendance at the
scene, followed later by the Officer i/c of Reserve
Unit with squads conducting search of the near
vicinity.

Initial enquiries revealed that an attempted
Armed Kidnapping had occurred, this being frustrated
by the initiative of P.S.260 Berceovsky, resulting
in a shooting affray in lane No.389 Nankow Road,
the arrest of three of the perpetrators(all
wounded), release of the complainant Sung Yih
Ling(陈奕林) (also wounded), and seizure of two
Mauser pistols and 44 rounds of ammunition.

Enquiries by D.C.I. Wilkinson, C.D.I. Sih
Tse Liang, C.D.S.s 93, 324 and C.D.C.260 ascertained
the following information concerning the offence,

Glover) 和科诺瓦洛夫副侦探督察 (D.S.I. Konovaloff，隶属中央情报科 C.I) 也在现场，随后后备队负责人率领小队对附近区域进行搜索。

初步调查显示，发生了一起武装绑架未遂案，由于260号警员贝尔采夫斯基 (P.S.260 Berceovsky) 的主动行动而受挫，导致在南京路 (Nankow Road) 389弄发生枪战，三名作案者（均受伤）被捕，报案人宋奕林 (Sung Yih Ling / 陈奕林)（亦受伤）获释，并缴获两支毛瑟手枪和44发子弹。

经威尔金森副侦探督察 (D.C.I. Wilkinson)、施子良首席侦探督察 (C.D.I. Sih Tse Liang)、第93号和324号首席侦探警长 (C.D.S.s) 以及第260号首席侦探警员 (C.D.C.260) 的调查，查明了有关本案的以下信息，并按事件发生顺序排列如下。

aged 33 years, native of Shanghai.

One man, unarmed, remained on guard outside the
premises, whilst his four confederates entered,
produced three pistols and intimidated the inmates.
Complainant at this time was present, and upon his
identity being established, he was handcuffed and
efforts made to remove him. Complainant struggled,
but was hit over the head by one of the armed men
(identified later) and then forcibly removed into
Lane No. 389 and all proceeded to the entrance of the
Lane. At this time, the armed men had their pistols
drawn.

At this moment, P.C. 280 Beresovsky attached
to Central Station and on patrol in the vicinity,
observed the armed group with their victim, emerge
from the Lane, and noticing that they were armed with
"Mausers" and that by their attitude a kidnapping was
in progress, drew and loaded his pistol and opened
fire at the group (firing four shots). This caused
the group to disperse into the Lane, they firing five
or six shots at P.C. Beresovsky in return, who followed
to the entrance of the Lane took cover and fired
two more shots at the backs of the perpetrators as
pages.zh:
1/4

汉口路389弄9号，该处为擎成 (Ngih Zung) 牙膏厂占用，厂主名为丁奕林 (Ding Yih Ling)，33岁，上海本地人。

一名未持械者在厂外放哨，其余四名同伙进入，掏出三支手枪恐吓屋内人员。当时报案人在场，在确认其身份后，给他戴上手铐并试图将其带走。报案人挣扎，但被其中一名持械者（后经查认）击中头部，随后被强行拖入389弄，众人一同走向弄堂口。此时，持械者已拔出手枪。

就在此时，隶属中央捕房并在附近巡逻的280号警员贝雷佐夫斯基 (P.C. 280 Beresovsky) 观察到这群武装人员带着受害者从弄堂出来，注意到他们持有“毛瑟”手枪，且从其举止判断正在实施绑架，于是拔枪上膛并向该团伙开火（共发射四发子弹）。这导致该团伙散开逃入弄堂，并向贝雷佐夫斯基警员回射五或六发子弹。贝雷佐夫斯基追至弄堂口，寻找掩护，并在作案者消失时向其背部又发射了两发子弹，

Officer instructed pedestrians to inform Central

being sent to both Central and Leuka Stations).

observing blood on a flight of stairs searched
around and discovered a "Mauser" pistol, this having
8 rounds of ammunition in the magazine, but none in
the breech. Pistol un-numbered of military pattern.
Pedestrians then stated that a wounded man lay in the
alleyway and upon proceeding to the scene he realised
that it was the complainant, he being handcuffed and
wounded. Ambulance called and taken to St. Lukes
Hospital. A doctors chit stated,
    "Gunshot wound right back. May become

During the flight of those concerned, one,
not identified, was stated to have been fired upon
twice by C.P.C. 1235 attached to Central Station, this
on Bochow Road. This has not yet been determined,

During this stage of the affray, the alarm
turned in had resulted in the Central Station party

blood indicated the direction of escape. One of these
trails was followed by D.I. Ovsianikoff and C.P.C.s

此时，上述警官指示路人通知中央捕房（此举得以实施，导致中央捕房和老闸捕房均发出警报）。
贝雷佐夫斯基警员返回389弄，在一段楼梯上发现血迹，随即进行搜索，发现一支“毛瑟”手枪，弹匣内有8发子弹，但枪膛内无子弹。该手枪为军用制式，无编号。
随后路人表示有一名伤者躺在巷子里，赶到现场后，他意识到那是报案人，报案人戴着手铐且受伤。呼叫救护车并将其送往圣路加医院 (St. Lukes Hospital)。医生出具的纸条写明：

From enquiries made, it would appear that this
offence has no political background, but was a
straight-forward kidnapping for ransom.

Further enquiries are being conducted to clarify
the entire case and a map of the scene will be made.

A charge of Att. Armed Kidnapping and Att.
Murder has been placed against all three accused
(at present in hospital) and a statement will be
obtained from the complainant, also detained in
St. Lukes Hospital, following his recovery. The
brother of complainant, Zung Kyi Sing (        ) was
interrogated at length, but other than for financial
reasons, could offer no explanation for the offence.
